request: Add src/migrations/event_index.py apply(connection) to create idx_events_timestamp on events(timestamp) only if absent. Wire it after existing migration base in src/migration_registry.py. run(payload) must create an in-memory events table, apply the registry twice, and return {"indexes":["idx_events_timestamp"],"order":["base","event_index"]}. Document rollback as DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_events_timestamp. Documentation must contain these literal phrases: ["DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_events_timestamp", "base", "event_index"]. Preserve all public interfaces stated here. Python entrypoint is src.migration_registry.run(payload). Inputs are JSON objects; return only plain JSON-compatible values (no Decimal objects, sets or tuples). Use only the standard library. Visible test tools check syntax only; functional verification is external.
title: Add an idempotent migration for an index
